facts.business: Gufic Biosciences Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of complex injectables, reproductive medicine, therapeutic toxins, natural products, nutraceuticals, and contract development and manufacturing services.

capacity_or_capex.item: R&D Capital Expenditure (Furniture, Fixtures, Computer & Others)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Scale the new facility; continue product transfers on a defined calendar; direct complex formats - depot, liposomal and suspensions - to the new site
guidance_or_targets.value: Scale output across settled cost base

guidance_or_targets.statement: Convert regulatory pipeline into market access; sequence European market entry as certifications arrive; advance US ANDA filings
guidance_or_targets.value: Sequence market entry as certifications arrive

guidance_or_targets.statement: Build newer platforms - aesthetics, chronic women's health, gastrointestinal therapy and advanced delivery formats - into meaningful contributors
Launch obesity portfolio (GLP-1 agonists) under capital expenditure model with product imported and marketed under international brand

key_risks: Working capital pressure from direct hospital billing model (now transitioned)
Concentration of external supply chains for active pharmaceutical ingredients
facts.related_party_note: The Company has transactions with subsidiaries Gufic UK Limited, Veira Life FZE, Gufic Ireland Limited, and Gufic Prime Private Limited. Key managerial personnel include Mr. Jayesh P. Choksi, Mr. Pranav J. Choksi, Mr. Pankaj J. Gandhi, Mr. Devkinandan B. Roonghta, and Ms. Ami N. Shah.
